effective_date_basis: There is no common revocation date: section 5(a) revokes five orders October 1, 1981, while section 5(b) revokes EO11659 January 1, 1982. target_effective_dates preserves those exact dates; the common date is deliberately null.

exceptions_savings.assessment: Section 1 terminates commissions September 30 or December 31, one day before the corresponding formal revocations. Sections 2-4 provide closeout, asset transfers subject to OMB approval and continuing federal coordination.
leads: Do not flatten different target dates into one family date.
Inventory earlier commission termination and continuing closeout or transfers separately.

legal_effect: Research lead only. Express revocation/supersession does not establish first substantive cessation, extinguish saved effects or change any provisional status.
